entry.title: New: Resolution 551 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE, OFFICE OF JUSTICE PROGRAMS, PURSUANT TO HAWAIʻI REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7, FOR A GRANT TO THE HAWAI‘I POLICE DEPARTMENT

Allows for the receipt of $50,537 of federally-derived funds to fund travel and training to increase the efficiency and readiness of the Police Department’s Special Response Team.
